answer: Operator-Clawback Lease. Each agent wallet acts under a renewable lease tied to one operator account, which posts a public performance deposit. If a wallet is flagged as a clone, the operator's deposit is docked and all its leases get shorter renewal windows. The attacker pays per identity beyond the deposit: fresh operator accounts must clear a longer timber audit before issuing leases. Clones also forfeit any lagoon storage credits the operator holds, and every new lease needs a wharf endorsement slot the operator can only refill slowly.
